product.title: Anchorage Greenbelt Bike Tour
product.description: Ride Anchorage's connected greenbelt trail system with a local guide and a steady pace suited to active travelers. This small-group outing links forested creek corridors, coastal viewpoints, and park stops while keeping logistics simple with downtown pickup. Along the way, watch for local wildlife and get context about Anchorage neighborhoods, landscapes, and trail culture.
highlights: Explore Anchorage's greenbelt trail network on a guided bike tour
Ride through creek corridors, city parks, and coastal viewpoints
Downtown Anchorage pickup and drop-off simplify logistics
Bike, helmet, and cycling gloves are included

start.description: Dena’ina Civic and Convention Center, 600 W 7th Ave, Anchorage, AK 99501, USA. Pickup is outside the Dena'ina Convention Center.

additionalInfo: Confirmation will be received at time of booking
Travelers should have a moderate physical fitness level
